name: talos-tools
description: Slash commands for Talos-backed Angular apps: /talos-init bootstraps the integration (private-registry .npmrc, installs @saicongames/talos-integration-angular, writes environment.ts, wires TalosModule.forRoot), /talos-feature scaffolds a typed service + component + view for any Talos entity wrapping TalosService, and /talos-feature-list scaffolds a component + module that renders an entity list with the ready-made <talos-list> component (presenter + #defaultItem card, auto loading/paging/empty state).
